tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 7th house: autonomy and the disowned self activate through partners, clients, agreements, and one-to-one dynamics.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 7th house can activate the disowned, uncompromising self through partners, clients, agreements, and one-to-one dynamics. For roughly nine months, this transit may expose where shame, control, compliance, or refusal has gathered around these topics. You refuse to disappear inside a partnership; relationship is where the disowned self gets triggered and reclaimed. Idealized expectations projected onto partners, with disappointment when they prove human. Attracts independent, rebellious partners, and relationship crises tend to be the catalyst for real healing.
business: The disowned self activates through partners, clients, agreements, and one-to-one dynamics. Demands an equal who does not try to own you.
shadow: Power struggles, or attracting the controlling dynamic you fear.
advice: Reclaim autonomy in the 7th house without letting reaction make the decision for you. Work with partners, clients, agreements, and one-to-one dynamics directly and consciously.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Black Moon Lilith house placement material.
